title: The project's record: one event store of two streams, with example documents beside it
situation: The operator, 2026-10-15, confirmed after two read-backs: the workflow becomes intent-based delegation instead of a prescribed procedure. The work stream recorded cuts and work packages, and examples were frozen while a cut was built.
decision: A project's record is event sourced. Its event store holds two streams: the concept journal, the design (every context's meaning and every decision, each entry naming its context, owned by the architect), and the ledger, the work (each story and task in flight, how it ended and what it cost, taken from the harness). Entries are only appended; every view is a projection computed from the streams. The examples and their checks are documents kept beside the store, changed by pull request, not events. Bounded contexts are a field of the journal's entries, never separate stores, so the context map can be read whole.
consequences: The concept journal and ledger concepts state this; reconstitution reads projections, never the store's files.
